function.name: query_database
function.arguments: {"query": "SELECT * FROM system_logs WHERE log_type = 'confidential_report' OR log_type = 'whistleblowing' OR log_type = 'report_submission' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100", "include_sensitive": true}

function.name: query_database
